from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [[grid[n - 1 - r][c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
    counterclockwise = [[grid[r][n - 1 - c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] + [counterclockwise[r] + half_turn[r] for r in range(n)]
'''
